name: zsnd_sample_set_playback_event_handler
description: zSndSample::SetPlaybackEventHandler stores a playback event callback only when the sample create guard is clear.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound sample/playback source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a1240 validates fastcall ECX=self and EDX=callback, createGuard test at offset 0, callback write at zSndSample offset 0x2c only when the guard is zero, and void return.
The native zSound smoke verifies setting, guarded preservation, and clearing of zSndSample::playbackEventHandler.
